name: ORION Holdings Corp.
summary: ORION Holdings Corp. manufactures and sells confectioneries in South Korea, China, and internationally. The company operates through Confectioneries, Entertainment, Construction, and Others segments. It provides pies, chips, cookies, fruit juices, cakes, chocolates, baked breads, jellies, energy bars, protein drinks, protein balls, brownies, cheese chips, potato snacks, mineral water, nutritional supplements, biscuits, snacks, and rice crackers.
